title: Never trust a save file
description:
Validate a save file completely before using any of it.

```
good file -> loaded: level 3, 2 items
truncated file -> refused: header says 2 items, data for 1
item id 9999 -> refused: unknown item
negative gold -> refused
```
hints: A reader with a position that returns false when asked for more bytes than are left makes every read safe (lesson 17.04).
Checking `count <= (bytesLeft / sizeof(item))` before reading the items catches truncated files and huge counts.
requirements: Read into local values with bounds-checked reads; never trust a count or length from the file.
Load into a temporary object and replace the real game state only when everything passed.
stretch: Feed it to the fuzzer in this milestone's last project.
